status: No blocker found in the reduction fix or focused regression
fix: Snapshot shared[0] into a thread-local register, then block barrier, then return. All callers are uniform and the reduction tree/FP32 order is unchanged.
coverage: Audio557x1024 with bias and vision31x1280 without bias use the actual production kernel and 256-thread block. Numeric oracle mirrors the FP32 block tree; repeat and guard checks are independent of that oracle.
resource_cost: One synchronization barrier per helper call; LayerNorm calls it twice. No tensor allocation, VRAM growth or arithmetic reordering. End-to-end performance is not established by the correctness test.
limitations: Racecheck and numeric tests establish the kernel defect and repair, not that every previous full-model difference had this single cause. Audio optimization qualification remains pending a corrected baseline and fresh A/B.
